purpose: Interpret one schema-valid Steps projection, schema version 1, into the type-specific body of a Canonical Revision through the interpret-source-projection@1 processor interface: the source step count in its canonical count unit, checked against the pinned Health Connect SDK's bounds, without deriving totals, allocating counts across local days, merging records, or converting units.

inputs.name: steps_record
inputs.description: The decoded record object of one Steps projection, schema version 1, as interpret-source-projection@1 passes it after closed-schema validation, the year-range and reversed-interval checks, and time attribution: start and end instants with their optional offsets, and the step count.

inputs.name: temporal_header
inputs.description: The interval temporal header interpret-source-projection@1 built for the projection, with exact instants, applied offsets, local dates, and attribution for each endpoint.

inputs.name: sdk_bounds
inputs.description: The step-count bounds and the start-before-end rule that the pinned Health Connect SDK 1.1.0 StepsRecord constructor enforces, recorded in this unit's pack.

outputs.name: steps_body
outputs.description: The Steps body, version 1: the source count as an integer in the canonical unit count, with no total, rate, duration, local-day allocation, or copy of the header.

outputs.name: quarantine_outcome
outputs.description: A Quarantine with one of this processor's declared health-data-free reasons, steps-interval-empty or steps-count-out-of-range, and the JSON pointer of the offending source field, never a value.

owns: the Steps body, version 1, and its declared numeric field
the Steps validity rules beyond the closed schema: the pinned SDK's count bounds and its start-before-end rule
the Steps quarantine reasons and the source field each one names
does_not_own: envelope decoding, schema validation, the revision header, time attribution, Policy-Pending, or canonical bytes, which interpret-source-projection@1 owns
persisting outcomes, Processing Jobs, or Processor Generations
daily totals, overlap handling, day-crossing allocation, source selection, or duplicate grouping, which Phase 5 summaries own
